hazards.name: Wide Driveway Crossing

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk at Driveway
hazards.description: There is no painted crosswalk across the driveway to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians, despite the tactile paving.
hazards.location_in_image: The asphalt area between the two sections of sidewalk

hazards.name: Construction obstructions
hazards.description: Orange plastic barriers and construction materials block the right-side verge, creating a physical barrier for anyone attempting to walk there.

hazards.name: Multiple Conflict Points
hazards.description: Frequent garage doors and curb cuts create numerous points where vehicles may cross the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: The garage doors and driveway entrances along the building frontage

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right side is directly adjacent to the travel lane, offering no physical separation from moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Driveway conflict point
hazards.description: A garage entrance crosses the sidewalk, creating a point where vehicles may cross the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Debris and Weeds
hazards.description: Accumulated trash and weeds along the fence line and in sidewalk cracks can create minor trip hazards or an uninviting environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the base of the fence and in sidewalk joints

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Points
hazards.description: Multiple garage doors and curb cuts on the right side create frequent points where vehicles may cross the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the brick buildings

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: There is no physical or psychological buffer, such as trees or parked cars, between the sidewalk and the travel lane.

hazards.name: Uneven sidewalk surface
hazards.description: The large concrete slabs of the sidewalk appear uneven in places, creating a potential trip hazard.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near intersection
hazards.description: Parked cars on both sides of the street near the crosswalks obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs approaching the intersection

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes without a refuge island or curb extensions to shorten the exposure time.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface in the foreground is uneven and heavily patched, which could affect vehicle handling or pose a trip hazard if pedestrians cross mid-block.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Excavation
hazards.description: A large hole in the sidewalk and roadway area is fenced off, creating a total blockage of the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Lack of Temporary Walkway
hazards.description: No safe, separated path is provided for pedestrians to bypass the construction site, necessitating walking in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Adjacent to the construction fence in the roadway
